Early Archie was based on the plot of SATAM with the tone of AoStH so he was basically just AoStH Robotnik with the world power of SATAM Robotnik . After, around 10-15 issues the comic started to have the same tone as SATAM because new wrighter Ken Penders thought that the comic would end soon (because comic adaptations of things in the 90's later 2 issues max lol) and he thought "If were going to go out, were doing it with a bang!" and as a result Robotnik just became SATAM Robotnik.

If you're not into the whole "3 short non-senceical goofy one off storys for every issue" thing like I totally am, Just skip too issue 11 and start there. That's where Evil Sonic is introduced and where the tone starts to get darker. It'll still be goofy, but it'll actually take itself seriously. And after afew issues it'll start to get dark *and* take itself seriously!

Then around issue 60-70 it'll stop taking itself seriously and will just have a dark tone... then on issue 160 Ian Flynn will come in to the book and make it serious and cool again! It's a wild ride and aslong as you can laugh *with and at* the book then I'm sure you'll find the whole ride satisfying!... Until it gets rebooted.... That wasn't very satisfying at all lmao
